summary.heroCapability: Yes—places-01, 02, 09, 10 are suitable (all 1600px+). Places-09 is square format ideal for varied layouts. Places-02 and 10 show treatment/patient context (tallest at 2133px).

places-05 and places-08: Duplicate subject (same equipment, different staff member)
summary.designRecommendations: Clinic is well-represented by professional storefront and equipment shots. Enough quality imagery for hero sections and services gallery. Phone snapshots (places-04, 05, 08) lower overall professional presentation—consider supplementing with studio staff portraits. All images show modern facility with current technology (3D imaging, GBT machine).
gaps: Entire pack is 10 phone snapshots from the Google Business profile; no professional photography exists.
No team names, roles or headcount — at least three people appear across the photos.
Identifiable patients appear in places-02, places-09 and places-10: written consent required before publishing any of them.
No logo file exists as artwork — the mark is only legible inside photos of the signage and reception desk.
No interior shot of a waiting room or a treatment room empty of people.
summary.correctionNote: Editorial fields for places-04, -08 and -09 were corrected by the main session after viewing every image. The original pass misfiled a patient portrait as equipment, called a genuine clinic photo patient-submitted, claimed 05/08 were duplicates, and reported no gaps.
